policy.purpose: Normalize only evidence-backed same-person aliases or obvious non-person placeholders before stable person-ID freeze.
policy.raw_provenance: Segment source strings remain unchanged; this file is an auditable interpretation layer.
policy.disputed_identity: Do not merge when the evidence itself preserves a material identity dispute. Leave the raw candidate in REVIEW until resolved.

之侯/初无余/莽安.basis: Shiji Suoyin / Bamboo Annals tradition explicitly connects 王之侯, 初无余之 and 莽安 as the same ruler.

代王嘉赵嘉.basis: 赵嘉 was established as 代王 after the fall of Handan; title and personal name refer to one person.

卫考伯/孝伯.basis: The transmitted title variant is recorded as 卫考伯, also called 卫孝伯.

帝喾高辛氏.basis: Structural normalization of a legendary ruler label: title/name and traditional clan-style designation are stored separately.

帝挚高辛氏.basis: Structural normalization only; legendary identity remains in the LEGENDARY evidence layer and the raw string is preserved.

晋哀公/懿公/敬公.basis: Different transmitted sources use 哀公, 懿公 and 敬公 for the same ruler 骄.

晋孝公/桓公.basis: The ancient Bamboo Annals tradition calls 晋孝公 晋桓公.

晋静公/靖公.basis: 静/靖 is a transmitted title variant for the final Jin ruler 俱酒.

曲沃武公/晋武公.basis: 曲沃武公 was later recognized as 晋侯 and is the same person conventionally called 晋武公.

楚王比熊比.basis: CTP identifies 楚王比 and 熊比 as the same person.

楚王负刍熊负刍.basis: CTP identifies 楚王负刍 and 熊负刍 as the same person.

王保保/扩廓帖木儿.basis: 王保保 and 扩廓帖木儿 are names used for the same Yuan/Northern Yuan figure.

王延羲/王曦.basis: 王延羲 changed his name to 王曦 after accession.

王延钧/王鏻.basis: 王延钧 used 王鏻 after accession; the records describe one person.

王继鹏/王昶.basis: 王继鹏 later changed his name to 王昶.

翁/朱句.basis: The Yue ruler is transmitted as 王翁 and also as 朱句/州句.

鼫与/鹿郢/与夷.basis: The same Yue ruler is transmitted under 鼫/鼫与, 鹿郢 and 与夷/适郢 variants.

王光泰等夔东集团.action: Exclude this aggregate string from the person index; enumerate qualifying individuals separately if evidence supports them.

unresolved_review.卫疌伯/挚伯: Keep pending direct source verification of the title/name variant.
unresolved_review.卫贞伯/箕伯: Likely a transmitted title variant; direct source verification still required before normalization.
unresolved_review.夫谭/无谭: 夫谭 is independently attested; evidence that 无谭 is the same person has not yet been established here.
unresolved_review.虢宣公/虢季子白: Do not force-merge: scholarship preserves competing views that 虢季子白 may be 虢宣公 or a distinct related person.
unresolved_review.许庄公茀/苴人: Transmitted naming is unclear; retain REVIEW pending source reconciliation.
unresolved_review.韩共侯/懿侯韩若山: Sources connect 若山 with 懿侯, but the 共侯/庄侯 sequence has textual disagreement; keep REVIEW before canonical merge.
unresolved_review.鲁真公/慎公: Likely posthumous-title variant; direct source verification still required before normalization.
